metadata.title: Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Telangana State, 2024
metadata.publisher: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of Water Resources, RD & GR, Government of India & Ground Water Department, Government of Telangana
metadata.reporting_period: Assessment Year 2024 (As on March/May 2024 / Water Year 2023-24)
metadata.national_compilation_reference: National Compilation on Dynamic Ground Water Resources of India, 2024
metadata.methodology: Ground Water Resource Estimation Committee (GEC-2015) Norms via IN-GRES
metadata.license: Government Open Data License - India (GODL) / NDSAP

assessment_category_definitions.Safe: Stage of Ground Water Extraction <= 70% with no significant long-term water-level decline.
assessment_category_definitions.Semi-Critical: Stage of Ground Water Extraction between 70% and 90%.
assessment_category_definitions.Critical: Stage of Ground Water Extraction between 90% and 100%.
assessment_category_definitions.Over-Exploited: Stage of Ground Water Extraction > 100% (annual extraction exceeds annual extractable replenishment).
assessment_category_definitions.Saline: Ground water assessment units with poor chemical quality / high salinity.

metadata.mandatory_limitation: Groundwater-resource assessments evaluate macro aquifer replenishment vs extraction and DO NOT certify drinking-water potability. Never claim groundwater is safe to drink solely because an assessment category is Safe. Building-level tap-water quality, Krishna/Godavari municipal piped supply, TDS, hardness, pH, and private borewell depth require on-site testing and local records.
